provenance.method: Added Cambridge US biodiversity /ˌbaɪ.oʊ.dɪˈvɝː.sə.t̬i/ as an accepted variant; fixed populations and primary references are unchanged. The archived full rule snapshot contains the biodiversity row and its prediction already matches this source, increasing the re-scored full-cohort baseline by one strict case and leaving lenient and top-5000 counts unchanged. This is a reference correction, not a pronunciation gain.
